MUS_01.label: Weaker muscles than usual
MUS_01.question: Do your muscles respond with less strength than usual when you do the same task?
MUS_01.source: Edu's team symptom guide (Edu, 2026-11-14), section 1; [1] https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/muscle-risk/ . ALM_01.label: Sudden vision loss or a new dark or missing area
ALM_01.question: Have you noticed a sudden loss of vision, or a new dark, empty or missing area in what you see?
ALM_01.action: Stop the risky task and tell the crew medical officer immediately.
ALM_01.source: Edu's team symptom guide (Edu, 2026-11-14), section 3; [4] https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20220014606 . Not a diagnosis of SANS; prototype triage proposal.

ALM_02.label: New distortion in the centre of vision
ALM_02.question: Do you newly see straight lines bent, letters deformed or a distortion in the centre of your vision?
ALM_02.source: Edu's team symptom guide (Edu, 2026-11-14), section 3; [4] https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20220014606 . Not a diagnosis of SANS; prototype triage proposal.

ALM_03.label: Sudden weakness or cannot move safely
ALM_03.question: Do you have weakness that came on suddenly, or that stops you from moving safely?
ALM_03.action: Get medical attention and assistance immediately.
ALM_03.source: Edu's team symptom guide (Edu, 2026-11-14), section 3. Not a diagnosis of SANS or muscle atrophy; prototype triage proposal.

ALM_04.label: New severe pain with other warning signs
ALM_04.question: Do you have new severe pain together with vision changes, marked weakness or difficulty doing a basic task?
ALM_04.action: Get medical attention immediately to find the cause.
ALM_04.source: Edu's team symptom guide (Edu, 2026-11-14), section 3. Not a diagnosis of SANS or muscle atrophy; prototype triage proposal.

ALM_05.label: New double vision or severe headache with neurological signs
ALM_05.question: Do you have new double vision, or a severe headache with neurological signs?
ALM_05.action: Stop the risky task and tell the crew medical officer immediately. Get urgent medical assessment; do not assume this is SANS.
ALM_05.source: Edu's team symptom guide (Edu, 2026-11-14), section 3, note after ALM_04; immediate-action wording follows section 3 alarm response. Question and triage wording are prototype proposals, not a validated questionnaire or a diagnosis of SANS.
